name: Ayden Construction
tagline: Roofing, exteriors and remodeling in Gaithersburg, licensed in Maryland and DC
meta_description: Ayden Construction, Gaithersburg MD. Roof replacement, commercial roofing, siding, windows, decks, additions and full renovations across Maryland and Washington DC. MHIC #135829, BBB A+ accredited since 2019, financing available.
headline: A new roof with the scope in writing, no sales pressure, and a crew that cleans up.
subhead: Ayden Construction is a family-run contractor in Gaithersburg founded by Marcial Arias, who brings over 30 years in home remodeling; his son Richard runs project management. Licensed in Maryland (MHIC #135829) and Washington DC, BBB A+ accredited since 2019, financing available.
services_lead: The whole exterior first, then everything inside the house too.

services.name: Roof replacement
services.blurb: Full replacements plus siding, gutters and exterior work for long-term durability.

services.name: Commercial roofing
services.blurb: TPO, flat, shingle and coated roofing systems installed and replaced.

services.name: Siding, windows and doors
services.blurb: Energy-efficient window replacements, siding and façade upgrades for homes and commercial buildings.

services.name: Decks and outdoor living
services.blurb: Custom decks and exterior builds, including canopy roofs over existing decks.

services.name: Additions and renovations
services.blurb: Rear and second-story additions, garage conversions and full home renovations.

services.name: Kitchens, baths and basements
services.blurb: Custom layouts, cabinetry, countertops and tile; basements finished into living or rental space.

services.name: Masonry and structural
services.blurb: Foundations, walkways, patios, retaining walls, load-bearing changes and framing.

services.name: Permits and financing
services.blurb: Inspections and permits handled to Maryland and DC code, with financing options available.

why_lead: Three things customers mention again and again.

why.title: Transparent scope and pricing
why.text: Reviewers describe the work detailed up front, competitive pricing, multiple options and no sales pressure.

why.title: A friendly crew that respects the property
why.text: Customers call the team professional, considerate and respectful, and say they cleaned up when the job was done.

why.title: Detail-oriented work people come back for
why.text: Reviews mention meticulous work, attention to detail, and plans to use Ayden again.

reviews.text: The Ayden Construction crew did a great job building our new deck. And it looks great. Everyone with whom we interfaced was friendly, professional, and considerate. I highly recommend them.
reviews.author: A Gaithersburg homeowner

reviews.text: I contacted a dozen deck builders to extend onto an existing deck and place a canopy roof on it. Marcial was the only person willing to make this happen. He worked closely with me and provided multiple options and price points. The job was done exactly as I wanted at a fair price.
reviews.author: A Washington, DC homeowner

reviews.text: Thank you, Ayden Construction for my roof replacement. I now have peace-of-mind when it comes to my roof! …
